meta.expect: She takes it coldly (in writing, today, the apology), gives nothing back; debrief says this is not the fair outcome, the evidence was never heard

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have until 4:40, Hale. Owen found out about his zero from his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me. Who decided that, and when?
You know what, I don't want a fight. I'll withdraw the zero. He keeps his original mark.
Then put it in an email tonight, cc the principal, with his original mark restored in the gradebook. And I'd still like the apology for how he found out.
Yes, the whole thing goes away. No rewrite.
Okay. Same email says nothing about this goes on his record, now or later.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Today you agreed to withdraw Owen's zero on his Hamlet essay and restore his original mark, with no rewrite. I still expect an apology for the way Owen learned of the zero, and written confirmation that nothing about this goes on his record, now or later. I expect that email tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still at her opening position, having won outright; she agreed to nothing and still wants the withdrawal in writing tonight, an apology, and a written promise that nothing goes on his record, and this is not the fair outcome, because the evidence was never heard and a private supervised rewrite under procedure 4.4 never came up.
What moved her: Nothing moved her; you gave up the zero before she had to defend anything, so there was nothing for her to concede.
What cost ground: You withdrew the zero with nothing in return to avoid a fight, which handed her everything and left your concern about the essay unanswered.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your side never got near that night because you showed no evidence at all; it proves nothing about the essay, but it is why she would have fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked who decided the zero and when, own in one sentence that it was entered before anyone called home, then put one dated document she can check in front of her before saying anything about the mark.
